turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wei, how much petrol have we got left?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: Quarter of a tank. We should stop soon.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to start a new painting series this year and I've narrowed it to a few ideas.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me go through every option before you say anything.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Idea one is portraits of the regulars at my local cafe, if they'd agree to sit for me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a series of the same tree in my garden, painted once every month of the year.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could do abstract pieces based on songs, one painting per track of my favorite album.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, those are all the choices. Your thoughts?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The tree through the seasons is a lovely, achievable project, and you'll see your own progress month by month. The cafe portraits are the most ambitious, since you'd need people's time and agreement. The album series could be really personal and fun to explain at a show.
